metadata.title: Robinhood inks prediction markets deal with Crypto.com: What to know

content.text:
00:00 Speaker A
Robin Hood strikes deal with crypto.com in latest prediction markets push.
00:05 Speaker A
So we had talked about that they were potentially doing this. Clearly prediction markets are commoditized here and for a platform like Robin Hood, it makes a hell of a lot of sense.
00:15 Speaker A
for them to work with multiple potential partners to provide different kinds of uh prediction markets. So they signed a multi-year deal here with crypto.com
00:24 Speaker A
and its prediction market exchange and clearing house OG.com. So interestingly crypto.com had recently gotten a massive uh
00:31 Speaker A
investment from Citadel. So, I I don't remember the evaluation, 20, 30 billion, something like that. I think it was around 20 billion. Uh and Robin Hood as a part of this is actually getting a uh stake here in both crypto.com and OG, which are minority stakes, of course.
00:45 Speaker A
So Robin Hood will be routing some event contracts through OG while continuing to use Kalshi and all of their other providers. They are very very promiscuous when it comes to who they'll do prediction markets with.
00:54 Speaker A
Robin Hood's doing prediction markets with people all over the place. They don't even care.
00:59 Speaker A
No, no standards.
01:03 Speaker A
Uh so this additional expansion includes football contracts with an election focused product hub planned, but this is mostly football. Now,
01:12 Speaker A
if you look back, right, customers traded 13.6 billion event contracts during the second quarter, including approximately 5 billion connected to the World Cup. So obviously the World Cup was a huge catalyst.
01:21 Speaker A
Now we have the NFL football season starting tonight. Crazy, because it's a Wednesday and now we do football on Wednesdays.
01:29 Speaker A
Right? Uh so it's starting tonight. So obviously looking to capitalize on actual football that the Americans play with the oblong ball that doesn't use your feet.
01:38 Speaker A
So, uh, yeah, this is a massive move once again by Robin Hood into the prediction markets, uh, world becoming the everything app for everything and everywhere and everyone.
